description.subject: Young woman, around early 20s, fair skin, shoulder-length voluminous curly auburn / copper-red hair, defined dark eyebrows, dark eyeliner, red lips, thin necklace chain at the neck
description.pose: Standing leaning her back and shoulder against a graffiti-covered wall, right arm raised with the hand resting on top of her head in her hair, left arm bent across her waist under the chest, left leg bent with the knee lifted forward and the foot pressed flat against the wall, right leg straight supporting her weight, chin raised and head tilted back, gazing toward the camera with half-lidded eyes

clothing.top: Black cropped tank top / bralette-style crop top with wide straps, exposing the midriff
clothing.bottom: Light-to-medium wash blue baggy wide-leg jeans with a low-rise fit, side cargo-style pocket and loose hems
clothing.footwear: Black and white low-top sneakers (panda colorway, Nike Dunk style) with white socks
clothing.accessories: Red and dark beaded bracelets on the raised wrist, thin chain necklace, sunglasses tucked into her hair on top of the head

description.setting: Outdoor urban sidewalk alongside a long concrete wall covered in colorful graffiti murals stretching into the distance, dusty pavement path in the foreground, small weeds and grass growing at the base of the wall, trees and a sliver of blue sky in the upper-left background
description.lighting: Bright natural daylight, strong direct sun from the front-left creating crisp highlights on skin and denim and hard shadows on the wall, sunny clear day
description.composition: Vertical full-body shot from a low angle, subject placed on the right side of the frame against the wall, strong leading lines of the wall and sidewalk receding into the left background, shallow depth of field with the far wall and trees softly blurred
description.style: Photorealistic street-style fashion editorial photography, Y2K / streetwear aesthetic, high detail, crisp and slightly contrasted color grading
description.colors: Faded denim blue, black, white, copper-red hair, warm skin tones, multicolored graffiti with red, teal, pink, grey and white, beige concrete sidewalk, green foliage, blue sky
description.mood: Confident, cool, carefree, sunny urban vibe
